summary: Printable / PDF customer statement (queue Q20, Workshop dashboard/web-app/customers/customers-pages revision ab75381d, option 07). New Owner/Admin finance query customerLedger.statementPdf renders an A4 PDF of one customer ledger account for local dates: business and Store header, customer, opening balance before the start date, dated charges and payments with a running balance, closing balance and optional How to pay from Finance bank money accounts. It reads the same pinned snapshot and uses the same finance gate as customerLedger.statement; merchant entry notes are never printed. The dashboard statement gains Print or save as PDF and the native statement Share/Save PDF. Read only; no ledger, finance or schema write. Local only; no deployment; UI acceptance deferred.
noAssistantImpact: No capability changes. The assistant already reads the same statement figures through customers.statement.read; producing and delivering a PDF file is a client action, so customerLedger.statementPdf stays planned under E02 with the rest of customerLedger.

procedures.reason: Read-only Owner/Admin file output for the merchant to print, download or share. Not an assistant tool yet: the assistant answers statement questions with customers.statement.read, and sending a statement file to a customer would need the same manual-delivery review as the WhatsApp account summary (E02).

evidence.result: 6 pass, 20 expects: running balance, empty period, negative refusal, customer-facing words, money words and file name, rendered PDF text.

1 pass, 12 expects on the verified local profile: opening/lines/closing, period after the opening, empty earlier period, pinned snapshot, bank details on/off, invalid dates and snapshot, MANAGER and foreign tenant refused; QA tenant cleaned.
8 pass, 159 expects: statementPdf listed, unauthenticated and MANAGER callers refused before DB effects, reversed dates and tenant override rejected by the strict schema.
